name: Business Facilitation Unit Residence & Work Permit (Company of Foreign Interest)

requirements.blocker_text: Where foreign participation in the company's share capital is 50% or less of the total, that foreign-held portion must itself represent at least EUR 200,000; this capital test does not apply where foreign participation exceeds 50%.
requirements.fix_path: Structure the company's share capital to meet the foreign-participation test.

requirements.blocker_text: High-skilled third-country employees must earn at least EUR 2,500 gross per month and hold a university degree (or equivalent) or 2+ years' relevant experience, under a contract of at least 2 years.
During the company's first 5 years under the scheme, third-country nationals may not exceed 70% of all staff (30% for support staff).

evidence_required.document: Company registration under the Business Facilitation Unit framework
Employment contract (2+ years) and qualification/experience evidence

outcome.duration_length: tied to the employment contract (2+ years), renewable

sources.title: SC Law Cyprus -- Business Facilitation Unit (BFU) requirements

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Cyprus's initial build. This is a genuinely distinct, fast-track scheme (one-stop-shop via the Ministry of Energy, Commerce, Industry and Tourism, per the EU home-affairs portal) from the ordinary cy_work_permit route -- kept as its own route rather than a group within it, since it has its own separate qualifying company-registration framework, staff ratios, and salary floor.
